## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm lint`, `pnpm build`, and `pnpm test` pass locally
- [ ] A changeset is included for any user-facing package change (`pnpm changeset`)
- [ ] No hand edits to generated content (`assets/`, `dist/`, per-emoji modules) — changes live in the sync/generator scripts
- [ ] Docs updated if package usage changed (pages are generated from package READMEs)
- [ ] Conventional-commit messages, no `Co-Authored-By` / AI-assistant trailer
